name: Robot copy of a particular person
definition: An android built as an exact double of a specific living or dead individual.

doubt: Teleoperated Geminoid (2006) stretches the definition; check whether any robot copy of a particular person fits, and whether there are earlier ones.

first_pass.what: Quisisana, the first documented automat (self-service restaurant), opened in Berlin. Horn & Hardart opened the first US Automat in Philadelphia in June 1902.
